title: Henri Poincare: Oeuvres, Tome I Source-Witnessed French/English Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Poincare record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record holds local poincare_v1_* source-witnessed working packages for Oeuvres, Tome I, with French source material, English translation working drafts, scans, render checks, and ledgers where included by package.

Initial dedicated update. Publishes the currently available local sequence through poincare_v1_26.zip. The latest package, poincare_v1_26.zip, covers source witnesses v1_0371-v1_0384 top and reaches the close of Section I of Sur les equations lineaires, before Section II Equations aux differences finies. It appends to the v1_25 recovery branch.

Continuity caveat. This is not yet a seamless continuous Tome I edition. The local poincare_v1_* packages currently present are v1_01, v1_02, v1_08-v1_21, and v1_24-v1_26; v1_03-v1_07 and v1_22-v1_23 are not currently present as local package artifacts. Existing packages are useful source-witnessed working drafts and recovery layers, but the record should be used package by package.

Quality note. These are working/source-witnessed drafts and repair/recovery packets, not certified critical editions. Source scans and ledgers are the authority; OCR/text extraction is only a locator/comparison aid. Verify important formulas, notation, theorem statements, and references against the included source witnesses.

Corrections and collaboration. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
version: 2026-06-13 dedicated Poincare Tome I working packages through v1_26
